entities.name: Hans Kahle
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans Kahle was a German communist journalist and military officer who commanded several units of the International Brigades and Spanish Republican Army during the Spanish Civil War. He later served as head of the Volkspolizei in Mecklenburg.
